| [ApiEndpointAttribute](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Documenting.Annotations.ApiEndpointAttribute.md) | Specifies an attribute for an API endpoint, allowing metadata such as name, description, and group to be associated with methods. |
| [ApiHeaderAttribute](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Documenting.Annotations.ApiHeaderAttribute.md) | Specifies an attribute for an API header, allowing metadata such as header name, description, and requirement status to be associated with methods. |
